Service Delivery Manager — AI Transformation & Operations Excellence · Webhelp-Concentrix | 2025 – Present | Gurugram
Engaged as internal AI transformation consultant; architecting enterprise-wide process re-engineering and AI- powered delivery programs across Insurance and eCommerce accounts, including global, multi-geography client portfolios — functioning as strategic advisor and execution lead simultaneously.
Global Client Management: Managed multi-geography client relationships and service governance across EMEA, APAC, UK and US portfolios, serving as the primary point of contact for global stakeholders and driving cross- border delivery alignment.
